courses.subject: QUEC
courses.title: Beginning Quechua I
courses.description: Intensive course for beginner students of Quechua. Students will develop basic listening, speaking, reading and writing skills in Quechua. Emphasis on oral production and comprehension skills. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.

courses.subject: QUEC
courses.title: Beginning Quechua II
courses.description: Continuation of intensive course for beginner level Quechua. Expansion on developing basic listening, speaking, reading and writing skills in Quechua. Emphasis on production and comprehension skills. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.

courses.subject: QUEC
courses.title: Intermediate Quechua I
courses.description: Intensive course for intermediate-level Quechua. Emphasis on oral and written production and comprehension skills. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.

courses.subject: QUEC
courses.title: Intermediate Quechua II
courses.description: Continuation of intensive course for intermediate-level Quechua. Emphasis on oral and written production and comprehension skills 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
